intro: Sri Lanka is a democratic republic with a powerful elected president.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president leads the government and appoints the cabinet. Parliament has 225 members. In 2024 Anura Kumara Dissanayake, a left-wing outsider, won the presidency and his alliance won a big parliamentary majority.

chapters.title: Provinces
text: Sri Lanka has nine provinces with their own councils, created partly to give Tamil areas more say.

keyTerms.meaning: A president who runs the government.
